name: VestigioCerimonial-v1
prompt: Use the RIGHT room R20 in the attached production concept as the art/style reference. Produce ONE isolated reusable game FLOOR DECAL, the faded ceremonial floor ornament from the center of that room, not the room itself. Orthographic straight-down 2D painted game art matching reference, antique warm grey limestone/dust colors. An elongated vertical floral funeral tracery pattern of curling leaves, tiny rosettes and long delicate interlacing vines, suggesting a once-rich processional floor engraving worn away by generations. World footprint roughly 7m wide by12m long. Marks must be thin pale desaturated ochre/grey scratched stone lines, low relief, fragmented and rubbed away into irregular holes. Large areas of real transparency BETWEEN the lines and around outer edges, no stone slab or stone ground backing. No rectangle border, no masonry blocks, no colored rug, no glowing magic circle, no text, no symbols from real religions, no objects. Delicate coherent symmetric tracery with uneven wear, asymmetrically missing about half the design. This is a transparent decal to layer on existing stone floor. Entire motif comfortably inside canvas. Output with genuine transparent background, soft painterly alpha at damaged lines. It should resemble a ghost of an inlaid floor rather than a bright new ornament. Preserve overhead perspective and practical painted-game rendering, no scene.
